evidence_kind: Matching PE/PDB static instruction evidence; host replay is separate verification, not execution of the original engine.

description.found_record: Copy TextData Description at +0x70, append nonempty AdditionalDescription at +0x88 without a separator. A known record with both empty produces empty text.
description.missing_record: Native logs and returns a placeholder; port keeps explicit failure until that branch is reconstructed.
description.export: Fields inherit independently, with explicit empty overrides; preserve field ambiguity and source provenance. Missing record is distinct from known empty.

create.owner: Id uses Lua integer conversion, low signed32 bits; absent/unconvertible/unresolved owner returns without a component. Inactive/dead owner behavior remains explicitly unsupported.
create.text: Nonempty RawText takes precedence. Otherwise nonempty Text with Bool(UseDescription,false) selects ShowDescription0x1745e0; default selects ShowDisplayName0x174550.
create.line_spacing: 0x180270e85..0x180270eae reads signed Int default0 into textbox runtime+b44/+b48 independently of AutoSetDataProperties.

row_pitch.formula: Maximum of base and each formatter font line spacing times its TextScale, plus that textbox runtime Top and Bottom. Integer spacing is added after scaling.
row_pitch.graft: Fresh TextSystem::Create/Clear zeros runtime spacing; GraftFrom copies ComponentData, not runtime Top/Bottom. See font-emphasis-contract.json.
row_pitch.limits: Existing portable wrapping/vertical-origin policy remains labelled; nonzero Left/Right spacing is explicitly unsupported.

bool_argument.conversion: Actual Lua booleans first; otherwise lua_isstring/lua_tolstring including numbers; exact case-sensitive true/false strings select value; unmatched values use supplied default.

toggle_move.state: Enabled default false stored in active PlayerUnitInput+0x8. New PlayerUnit input defaults enabled (0x1802ebda4).
toggle_move.consumption: HandleInput0x1802ed372 gates DirectMovement only. Lifetime identity keeps state from leaking to replacement units.

scope_limits: Emphasis exact map and single lookup are in font-emphasis-contract.json.
ModifySubtitles retains original suppression state; lyric presenters remain unrebuilt.
Dialog entry does not prove dialogue advancement or boon selection.
No original/derived game payload or disassembly is included in this contract.
